integrity: The proof is analytical and the reproducibility script supplies supplemental finite and symbolic calculations, without independent certification or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only unit-edge complete tripartite graphs \(K_{1,m,m}\) with \(m\ge2\), and nonnegative gains summing to \(B>0\). No gain caps or network perturbations. A general threshold is implicitly characterized by quintic roots.
title: Sharp nine-part cutoff and reentrant hub-gain blackout in \(K_{1,m,m}\)
